system.description: Like the protean Dracon, you are a whirlwind of temperaments touching your very psyche. Unlike multiple personalities, this doesn't give you more than one identity — you remain the same person, but with a Nature so mutable it can shift to fit the moment. At the beginning of each story, you may choose one Personality Archetype to function as your Nature for its duration; this doesn't change your identity, but alters how you perceive situations and deal with others. You regain Willpower according to your new Nature, and are affected by other effects or Discipline powers keyed to Nature accordingly. In MET terms, you may choose a new Nature at the start of each game session, though the Storyteller may at her leisure call you aside and swap your present Nature for a new one to act out.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
